_comment: Ammo Token counts that the card bundle does not carry. Rulebook 4.13: the Ammo Icon on an Action is a black pill whose marks say how many Ammo Tokens go on the card at Deployment, and each performance spends one (Volley X spends one per Projectile launched). The generated cards.json records storage 0 for 77 of the 78 Drone actions, so a missile drone showed no ammo at all. Every value below was read off the printed card scan in assets/cards/en/, not inferred. The printed card always wins over this file.
_scope: Only Drone actions that launch or deploy something are listed, because those are the ones whose printed Ammo pill is certainly missing from the data. A wider sweep of the remaining Drone and mech-part actions has not been done, so absence from this file does not mean an action has no Ammo.
_zero_means_unlimited: An Action with no Ammo pill printed on the card has unlimited uses; storage 0 is the right value for it, NOT a missing count. Confirmed 2026-07-29 for GSD7 Mortar (ZHLA-201_A), GLP-15 Mine Layer (006_B) and the MES Beacon Launcher (064_A), which print no pill and are unlimited. guidedActions already treats it that way: ammoLeft is undefined when storage is 0, so the Action is never blocked and no pips are drawn. Do not add counts for those three. RKG70 Ammunition Pack was queried at the same time and is already correct: its Ammo 2 belongs to Ammo Supply (086_A, which carries storage 2), while Ammo Delivery (086_B) is the Passive that lets a launcher draw from the pack and has no Ammo of its own. Still unverified for want of a card scan: PDBP-202_A, PDBP-202_B, PDBP-203_B, PDBP-204_B and TM39D_B.
_shape: actions maps an action id to its printed Ammo Token count.

_notes.079_A: DTG-30S "Hyena" Missile Type. Volley 2, so four tokens are two full volleys.
_notes.ZHDR-104_A: N14 Vanguard IV "Javelin". Fires one M707 "Swift" Missile per use; the pill shows two missile marks rather than the "!" bars the RDL cards use.
_notes.ZHDR-106_B: N113 Aegis II "Ballista". Same missile and same two marks as the Javelin.
_notes.ZHDR-201_B: N31 Hound I "Beagle". Volley 3 against three marks, so one full volley.
_notes.PRDR-101_B: MD-4A Reaper Type I. Volley 3 against six marks, so two full volleys.
_notes.PRDR-102_B: MD-4C Reaper Type III. Identical missile block to the Type I.
_notes.PRDR-203_A: LD-5B "Vigilant" Bombing Type. Volley 2 against four marks.
_notes.PRDR-204_A: LD-5S "Vigilant" Support Type. The same Cluster Grenade action as the Bombing Type but with half the ammo, which is the difference between the two variants.
_notes.PRDR-204_C: LD-5S "Vigilant" Support Type, Beacon. Not a Volley action, and proof that the gap is not limited to Volley actions.
